Module 1 — Quality Audit

Checkpoint-Level Audit Management.

5 user roles with granular RBAC. 7 discipline types (Structure, MEP, Architecture, Fire & Safety, Quality Docs + custom). Checkpoint-level photo evidence. Interim & final PDF reports with company branding.

RoleScopeKey Actions
AdminAll regions, all projectsCreate, Assign, Delete, Configure, Override
Project HeadOwn projectsReview, Approve, Return, Assign Auditees
AuditorAssigned projectsInspect, Record, Photo, Submit Reports

Audit Lifecycle

1.

Create Audit

2.

3.

5.
